'''Kevin Ray''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[January 2001 Phoenix tournament]] on 13 January 2001, according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1620">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-viper-pops-in-phoenix-az-1-13-01d1620/ viper-pops-in-phoenix-az-1-13-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 14 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-viper-pops-in-phoenix-az-1-13-01d1620/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
